copy.curiosityHook: When ruthless developers send violent crews to claim the city, can Master Ip's principled defense halt an organized criminal syndicate?
copy.description: In 1950s Hong Kong, Master Ip is forced into action when brutal gangsters directed by a crooked property developer launch an aggressive bid to seize control of the city.
copy.vibeSummary: Exciting and fast-paced martial arts action grounded by personal drama, built for an engaging watch alone or with friends.
copy.whyWatch: Wilson Yip delivers a fast-moving martial arts drama that pairs kinetic combat choreography with genuine emotional weight and high-stakes neighborhood conflict.

allowedMaterial: crooked property developer and gangsters making a play to take over the city
Master Ip taking a stand against the syndicate
excludedMaterial: fight outcomes and specific climactic duels
third-act character fates or late revelations
